from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Solid 9 lines divide a canvas into equal cells; copy the populated cell into each.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if all(v == 9 for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h))]
    if sep_rows and sep_cols:
        rb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
        cb = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
        cells = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1], cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])
                 for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
        src = next(((r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1,c0,c1 in cells
                    if any(g[r][c] != 3 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))), None)
        if src:
            r0,r1,c0,c1 = src
            tile = [g[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0,r1)]
            for a,b,x,y in cells:
                if (a,b,x,y) != src:
                    for r in range(a,b):
                        g[r][x:y] = tile[r-a][:y-x]
        return g
    # Otherwise repeat the initial tile, whose final column is a solid marker.
    tile_w = next((c+1 for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] and g[r][c] != 3 for r in range(h))), None)
    if tile_w is None:
        tile_w = w
    original = [row[:tile_w] for row in g]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            g[r][c] = original[r][c % tile_w]
    return g
'''
